ios.notes: bounded iOS-only compiled topology, typed stack protocol, UIKit host composition, marker/insets, and generated host proof are verified in Phase 161.1; fixture and simulator evidence remain advisory, TODO-002/adopter topology is unknown_blocking, and source-bound signed-device composition is required before physical or support promotion.

package_surfaces.release_burden: Hex package SemVer moves independently, while support truth still follows manifest_schema_version, bridge_protocol_version, and native_runtime_version.
package_surfaces.why: Route-policy DSL, manifest contract, compatibility axes, bounded-bridge vocabulary, shell generators, doctor, support matrix, release rules, and proof posture stay in one obvious Phoenix-first package.

package_surfaces.release_burden: Semantics may evolve in core, but provider adapters and native storefront logic remain outside the base package.
package_surfaces.why: `paywall_entry`, `purchase_intent`, `restore_intent`, `entitlement_snapshot`, and `reconciliation_evidence` stay normalized and backend-truthful in core without embedding storefront providers.

package_surfaces.release_burden: First-party companions declare minimum compatible ranges against core, compatibility axes, and capability-family majors.
package_surfaces.why: Storefront adapters, media/upload/capture, rollout, auth/session, notifications, and audit/operator seams carry native binary churn or backend coupling beyond core.

package_surfaces.release_burden: Not first-class supported as package surfaces; promotion requires reclassification plus proof and support-matrix updates.
package_surfaces.surface: Checked-in example hosts and install walkthroughs
package_surfaces.why: Examples, walkthroughs, reviewer playbooks, and vendor recipes teach boundaries and proof posture without becoming separate runtime packages.

package_surfaces.release_burden: Native core versions move in lockstep with the Hex package through release-please linked versions; clean-room proof verifies the external install path at release time.
package_surfaces.why: The generated shell stays host-owned, while reusable native core logic resolves from SwiftPM and Maven Central packages instead of monorepo-local paths.

phoenix.notes: Phoenix host install and manifest generation are the stable baseline.

release_boundaries.compatibility_contract: package versions alone do not define support truth; manifest_schema_version, bridge_protocol_version, and native_runtime_version stay canonical.
release_boundaries.release_rule: Manifest-major, bridge-major, and runtime-line changes must update support docs and doctor before release.
release_boundaries.versioning: Independent SemVer for the `crosswake` Hex package.

release_boundaries.compatibility_contract: Each companion declares minimum compatible ranges for core, all three compatibility axes, and exposed capability-family majors.
release_boundaries.release_rule: Companion support cannot expand until the adapter publishes explicit compatibility ranges and fail-closed guidance.

release_boundaries.compatibility_contract: Breaking bridge semantics require a bridge_protocol_version major bump plus a compatible shell artifact before support widens.
release_boundaries.release_rule: Changes touching native code, entitlements, permissions, registration, or packaged runtime behavior move the native_runtime_version line and mark rebuild required.
release_boundaries.versioning: SwiftPM core package version is lockstep with the Hex package; host app build numbers remain adopter-owned.

release_boundaries.compatibility_contract: Breaking bridge semantics require a bridge_protocol_version major bump plus a compatible shell artifact before support widens.
release_boundaries.release_rule: Changes touching native code, entitlements, permissions, registration, or packaged runtime behavior move the native_runtime_version line and mark rebuild required.
release_boundaries.versioning: Maven Central core artifact version is lockstep with the Hex package; host app build numbers remain adopter-owned.

shells.notes: Bounded iOS shell evidence excludes generic navigation, native leaf rendering, arbitrary restoration/modal breadth, and browser-history authority. Default non-local scaffolds resolve `https://github.com/szTheory/crosswake-shell-core-ios.git` via SwiftPM at the Crosswake package version; Release consumer proof resolves that public SwiftPM tag and builds a generated iOS app with `xcodebuild`. It must pass for the ordinary core release's six-child COMPLETE result. CI build proof does not establish physical-device or adopter-topology support.

Generated Android shell artifacts retain the frozen generator, Maven, JVM, and shared-vector posture based strictly on `JVM hermetic proof` via the merge-blocking android-generated-shell-unit CI lane (native-behavioral-proof-gate). JVM hermetic proof is not emulator evidence or physical-device proof. This existing posture is frozen during first adopter iOS readiness; no parity/device/template/release expansion is claimed.
